project.name: official_eval_gap_closure_llm13_t6_td_update_core_8_000001
project.description: Build an 8-bit TD-error value-update datapath as a complete SR2FPGA Verilog RTL project. This is component topology t6_td_update_core, difficulty tier T6. Use td_input_stage feeding discount_core, then td_update_core, then stream_stage. The design must implement this black-box behavior: a reward, value, next value, discount factor, and learning rate tuple is staged, converted into a temporal-difference error, and used to emit an updated value. Keep rtl/top.v as the integration wrapper and keep each reusable component in a separate RTL file. Preserve these interface contracts: top.in_valid -> td_input_stage.in_valid; top.reward -> td_input_stage.reward; top.value -> td_input_stage.value; top.next_value -> td_input_stage.next_value; top.gamma -> td_input_stage.gamma; top.alpha -> td_input_stage.alpha; td_input_stage.out_valid -> discount_core.in_valid; td_input_stage.reward_out -> discount_core.reward; td_input_stage.next_value_out -> discount_core.next_value; td_input_stage.gamma_out -> discount_core.gamma; discount_core.out_valid -> td_update_core.in_valid; discount_core.discounted_return -> td_update_core.discounted_return; td_input_stage.value_out -> td_update_core.value; td_input_stage.alpha_out -> td_update_core.alpha; td_update_core.out_valid -> stream_stage.in_valid; td_update_core.td_error -> stream_stage.td_error; td_update_core.updated_value -> stream_stage.updated_value; stream_stage.out_valid -> top.out_valid; stream_stage.td_error_out -> top.td_error; stream_stage.updated_value_out -> top.updated_value; top.out_ready -> stream_stage.out_ready. Include system_his.json, manifest.json, timing constraints, predicted QoR, and a bounded self-checking testbench that prints TEST_PASS only on success or TEST_FAIL on failure.
